policy: Conservative INITIAL budgets. CI reports misses as warnings only until a baseline week of measurements has been collected. Never lower a budget silently; any change must be justified with measured data.

bundle.policy: Initial bundle budgets. vite.config.ts prints [bundle-budget] WARN lines on a miss but the build still exits 0; no CI gate until a baseline week has been collected. Never lower a budget silently; justify changes with perf/bundle-sizes.json measurements.
bundle.units: decimal kB (1000 bytes) of emitted, uncompressed .js in dist/assets
